from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A parsed instance of one provided paper, capturing its identity and what other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str = Field(description="The exact title of this paper as named in the collection")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of other provided papers that appear in this paper's bibliography/reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
